reviews.x: Good product for peeling off dead skin   Wasn’t really expecting much to be honest. What I got was the equivalent of what I would get if I went to the salon! My feet are so smooth! They feel amazing!

I love these things! I wore the "socks" for about 1.5 hours. They did have a strong odor. Not chemical, but fragrance. My feet started to peel on about day 3. I covered them in lotion and put socks on. The next day they were peeling really well. Afterwards, my feet were very soft. They are still soft 3 weeks later.

reviews.t: Not what it's "Cracked" up to be
reviews.x: The heels of my feet get really dry and cracked in the winter. I tried this product as an alternative to a similar sold out product.  I followed the instructions (insert feet into provided disposable socks for 60-90min) and waited, and waited.  On day three my heels, even with Dr. Foot moisturizer were still very cracked. Okay, I'll wait another 1-2days and check back. WELL I noticed flakes of dry skin on my sofa (EWWW) and was like 🤔. Checked out my feet and saw very dry, very flaking skin. Ski

At first, I was skeptical, I mean it does sound a little crazy, but I was so wrong! It does exactly what it says it will! The directions are simple and straightforward. The boots themselves were not uncomfortable, and while I was wearing them I almost forgot they were on. After a few days, my foot started peeling. A lot of the skin came off at night, but my feet were still so soft after! My feet were not super dry or calloused, but the mask was still super hydrating. I would recommend getting it

I have used the Baby Foot brand in the past and feel like it works slightly better but for the price point of this product I am impressed. It took about 2 days for my feet to begin peeling. I lightly scrubbed them and a ton of skin came off. They were pretty smooth for about a week but I will need another one soon. This may be because summer was rough on my feet so hopefully a second one will bring them back to life. All in all I would reccomend this product.

I absolutely love these exfoliating foot mask! Now I get pedicures pretty regularly, at least once every 2 months the minimum but in between time I like to try home foot mask instead of overpaying at the salon spas, but this particular brand does exactly what they say they do. You will see your skin peeling days after but the softness of your heels is worth every peel, lol! I will definitely but these in the future again for sure!

I bought these foot masks for a date night with my husband. For me they worked fabulously and my feet are so amazingly soft. My husband on the other side (who arguably needed it to work more) showed no change. We did it together for the same amount of time and everything but his feet never peeled. They seem to be slightly softer but that’s it. But at your own risk and maybe one will work for you. Who knows.

This is a amazing product. My feet are baby soft. I recommend this product 100%.I love these things! I wore the "socks" for about 1.5 hours. They did have a strong odor. Not chemical, but fragrance.  My feet started to peel on about day 3. I covered them in lotion and put socks on. The next day they were peeling really well. Afterwards, my feet were very soft. They are still soft 3 weeks later.

I shouldve taken pictures. The footie bags seal really nice and did not leak out. The solution is absorbed in a thin gauze lining which I was very apprehensive about, but it worked well! I left on for about an hour and rinsed. A couple days later there was peeling!!! Most of the caluses are gone except one stubborn patch. . . that none get rid of on the first go.

The pic with buck is before applying the mask the second pic after one week. I kept it on for almost 2 hours while working and it stayed without any problem. After couple of days, i founds lumps of dead skin coming off during shower. It does take a layer of dead skin off the legs, leaving it clean and soft. Would buy again and  recommend.

reviews.t: Nice scent & helped to remove the dry skin that sticks to my socks!
reviews.x: I liked the scent & the product was easy to use. Following the directions of soaking your feet after is essential as it does help with the peeling process. Depending on your level of callus more than 1 attempt will be needed. Overall I was very satisfied with my results, the hard dry skin was removed and my feet felt smooth again.

This was the first time I used an exfoliating foot mask and I loved it. My feet are soft again!!! Very nice packaging, easy to apply, the fragrance is not too bad. Left the booties on for 90 minutes while I relaxed. I gave the other pair to my sister and she loved it as well. Great amazon find!

This product is easy to use and left my feet very soft right after the use, however there was no peeling skin. It’s been about 2 weeks since I’ve used the foot mask and have had zero peeling. My feet were pretty smooth for a few days after and then grew back the rough, dead skin.

Didn’t really work the way I wanted it too. I had some dead skin shed off but not a lot. I left it on for an hour (recommended time was 60-90 min) so maybe I should have left it on longer. Not a horrible product for the price but not really worth it

I have purchased the more expensive brands of foot peels before and this product works just the same for a much better price! My feet started peeling within 3 days. They are now much softer. Will definitely continue purchasing these.

I seriously love these foot peel masks. They seem scary, but are my new favorite thing because they make my feet soooooo soft. Yes, the peeling process itself is wild and gross, but totally worth it. I highly recommend this product!

I was skeptical getting this brand because it was a lot cheaper than the other one I had seen online. But wow it really works! On day 3 after using it, my feet started to peel and began to get really soft! Will definitely buy again!

It is an incredible product, I usually have quite dry feet and this has restored my hydration, it has been almost miraculous, after three days the dead skin begins to fall off and the skin is soft. I highly recommend this product.

reviews.t: Great For Crusty Dry Feet Repair
reviews.x: This product works great. I tend to wear sandals and my feet get very dry and crusty. These work great for somebody like me. I soak my feet for 10 minutes a day for a few days after I use it and moisturize them every day as well.

reviews.t: Worked Great.. My feet aren't getting stuck to my rugs and blankets
reviews.x: I decided to do this because the bottom of my feet became so dry and cracked that the skin was getting caught on clothing and a ton of different fabrics.  I only used it once so far, and the next day they are like baby smooth!!

I was expecting the whole tiktok , peel my whole foot and feel like baby feet thing but was disappointed when it made a small amount of my foot peel and that was basically it after 5 days , I would try a different brand.

I was skeptical that it would do the trick but it did.  My husbands callous peeled about 3-4 days after first usage.  U cant tell the difference right off the bat, but after a few days, his skin started peeling off.

Got as a Christmas present. First time user, but super easy to use. It smells good, has simple instructions, and even though I’m not fully peeling yet it looks like I’m going to have great results! Super excited!

It didn't work as well as I expected. I work on my feet all day, so obviously I had a lot of calluses. It just didn't really get them off like I wanted. It mostly got rid of my thin skin on the tops of my feet.

reviews.t: It works! Will always be my new go to
reviews.x: It does as discribed. It doesn't hurt and when the peeling process is done they're super soft, baby soft. It removes buildup safely and I'd definitely by it again. Save a lot of time of your feet maintenance 🙂

claims.text: Most users report that the mask effectively removes dead skin and leaves feet noticeably softer and smoother.
Peeling typically begins about 2-3 days after use, and many note that following the directions (including soaking) helps the process.
Several reviewers find it a good value compared to pricier brands or salon treatments, working just as well for less.
A few users report little to no peeling or that results faded and rough skin returned, sometimes noting inconsistent results between people.
Some reviewers mention a strong fragrance or odor from the product, though most find it tolerable.
